extracted.intended_audience: stand-up comedians and comedy writers focused on one-liners and dark/offensive material
extracted.subtask_description: Techniques for writing and performing tightly compressed, dark one-liners in a committed stage persona (Anthony Jeselnik style). Emphasizes setup/punch structure, persona consistency, and managing the tension between safety and violation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setup-and-punch-line format
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer concise setups leading directly to a punch; avoid long storytelling arcs. The form relies on engineering each joke rather than narrative biography.

rubrics_metrics.name: High laugh density
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for frequent, compact jokes rather than fewer long bits; keep pacing brisk so multiple laughs are delivered per minute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid storytelling; rely on engineering
rubrics_metrics.description: Not a storyteller — relies on engineering, not biography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design jokes as crafted machines: every word has a purpose for setup, pivot, or punch. Avoid personal anecdotes unless they can be compressed into the one-liner structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joke-as-machine (setups subvert expectations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each joke = a finely tuned machine. Sets up expectations only to subvert them with punchlines that hit harder than expected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Construct setups to create a specific expectation; use the punch to sharply violate that expectation so the payoff is stronger than the implied trajectory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comedic conflict: balance safety and violation
rubrics_metrics.description: The delicate balance between safety and violation; deliberately leads audiences into uncomfortable territory; knowing the resulting tension will amplify the eventual release; operates near the edge of 'too far.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intentionally cultivate tension by approaching taboo or offensive content while keeping just enough safety for the audience to stay with you; the closer to the edge, the greater the release—monitor audience response to find that edge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Anti-comedy approach centered on unwavering commitment to character. Maintains arrogant persona throughout. Refuses to soften with smiles or self-deprecation. Prevents audience from dismissing it as 'just a joke.' Forces them to confront the violation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustain a single, uncompromising persona (e.g., arrogant, unapologetic); never break character with smiles, qualifiers, or apologies. The persona's refusal to soften is part of the joke's force.

rubrics_metrics.name: Jeselnik joke structure
rubrics_metrics.description: 1. Innocuous setup ('My grandmother got hit by a car…') 2. Sharp pivot via word choice 3. Dark/disturbing reveal 4. No softening, no 'I'm kidding'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write setups that appear harmless or explanatory, engineer a pivot (often a single word or phrase) that reroutes meaning, land a dark reveal that contrasts with the setup, and deliver without hedging or rescuing the audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the setup deceptively innocent?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether the setup leads the audience to a benign expectation; stronger deception heightens the impact of the pivot and reveal. Anti-pattern: setup that already signals the dark turn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the punch hit darker than the setup signaled?
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the punch hit darker than the setup signaled?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure the gap between expected tone and delivered punch—the greater the controlled disparity, the stronger the laugh. Avoid predictable or mildly darker punches that fail to surprise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the persona consistently committed (no break)?
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the persona consistently committed (no break)?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for any moments of apology, smile, or self-deprecation that would undermine the persona. Consistent delivery reinforces the audience's inability to dismiss the material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the joke maximally compressed?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remove extraneous words; every syllable should serve the setup, pivot, or punch. Compression increases density and reduces opportunities for the audience to reframe or diffuse the violation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the comedian refuse to apologize?
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the comedian refuse to apologize?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain refusal to apologize as a deliberate performance choice; apologizing or backtracking weakens the power of the violation and lets the audience off the hook.
